name: skin-assistant-promptfoo-evaluation
description: 澄肌护肤助手的独立 Promptfoo 黄金集评测工程

scripts.eval: CATALOG_SOURCE=mock PROMPTFOO_PYTHON=../.venv/bin/python PROMPTFOO_CONFIG_DIR=.promptfoo PROMPTFOO_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=true PROMPTFOO_CACHE_TYPE=memory node ./node_modules/promptfoo/dist/src/entrypoint.js eval -c promptfooconfig.yaml --output reports/golden-results.json
